beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Course cards can now open Schoology alerts directly, and preferred student names carry through roster sync and appear in Schoology work-sample headers.
• PDF compression now offers safer built-in choices, Settings controls are easier to find, and update prompts let you skip one specific version without hiding newer updates.

Fixes:
• Fixed Schoology connection and re-download errors that could close the app instead of returning to a usable state.
• Dates outside the active learning period are now rejected while grading instead of being saved to the wrong period.
• Fixed videos and other samples with cached analysis opening to an empty verification window. Their pages now appear immediately in both Simple and Advanced modes without requiring Restart.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
